title: Mouse Drift City (with bouncing Yaris) by Azq2337
author: Azq2337
selftext:
Play the entire game with Mouse Only!

Made this game in GPT5.6 entirely, no hand code, but days of prompting to fix bugs and add features, also fine tuning the game feel.  
Personally I enjoy the current gameplay, brings me nostalgia for old Nokia phone racing games.  


Tools used are:  
\- Odin language for low level, Raylib for graphics, Box3d for physics.

Video showcase: [https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nfBdpgHODSE](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nfBdpgHODSE)  
The game is completely free and open source: [https://github.com/Azq2337/Mouse-Drift-City-Odin](https://github.com/Azq2337/Mouse-Drift-City-Odin)
